sentences.text: Rajendra Ram Chauhan Jailakhan Ram Aged About 26 Years

Village-Devri,( Foskotoli ), Chowki-Dokla, Ps- Kansabel, Distt-  Jashpur (C.G.).
 ------Applicant  VERSUS   State Of Chhattisgarh through - The Station House Oicer,
 Outpost- Dolkda, Police Station - Kansabel, District - Jashpur  (C.G.).
 -------Non-applicant  For applicants : Mr. Jitendra Kumar Saxena, Advocate  For Non-applicants-State : Ms. Raashi Tiwari, Panel Lawyer  SB:
Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge
ORDER ON BOARD  16/04/2024 1.

This is the irst bail application iled by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail, as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 16/2023 registered at Outpost- Dolkda,
Police Station - Kansabel, District - Jashpur, Chhattisgarh for the ofences punishable under Sections 363, 366-a, 376 (2) (n) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 04 & 06 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Ofences (POCSO) Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Ofences (POCSO) Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Case of the prosecution is that, father of the victim lodged a report in the concerned police station alleging that his daughter is found missing from his house.
Based upon which, initially, crime was registered for the ofence punishable under Section 363 of IPC.

During the course of investigation,
victim was recovered from Goa in possession of the applicant, Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:13741 her statement was recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., thereafter, other ofences were also added and applicant was arrested on 01.07.2023.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the instant crime, he has not committed any ofence as alleged.
He submits that when the victim was working as a Labourer in Goa, they met and thereafter, they performed marriage.
They were residing together as husband and wife.
Victim on the date of incident was more than 18 years of age, hence, no ofence as alleged would be attracted.

Applicant is in jail since 01.07.2023,
therefore, he may be enlarged on regular bail.
4.
On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes the submission made by learned counsel for the applicant and would submit that on the date of incident, age of the victim was 16 years and 11 months.

5. Pursuant to the notice issued by this Court, victim appeared before this Court through virtual mode from D.L.S.A. Jashpur and submitted that she is having no objection in grant of bail to the applicant.
6. At this stage, learned counsel for the respective parties also submit that pursuant to the marriage and physical relation between the two, victim delivered a child on 06.10.2022.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the respective parties.

8. Taking into consideration, facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegations, submission of learned counsel for the respective parties as also, the date of arrest of the applicant, Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:13741 without commenting anything on the merits of the case, I am inclined to allow this application for grant of bail.
9.

Accordingly, the bail application iled under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety in the like sum to satisfaction of Trial Court concerned on the conditions that:
(i) He shall appear before the Trial Court concerned regularly on each and every date unless exempted from appearance.
(ii)He shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
(iii) If applicant is found involved in similar ofence in future, it will be open for the State to apply for cancellation of bail.
Certiied as per rules.

Sd/-
